Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The hosting service's effective, non-secret configuration. Members the deployment does not configure are absent; nothing here is a secret, and a consumer MUST NOT add one under ext.

advertisedServices.description: `service[].type` values of the service's own resolved DID document. Absent when it could not be resolved. What the configuration enables and what the document advertises can differ; both are shown so an operator can see it.

deploymentMode.description: Implementation-defined deployment shape (e.g. a single-process daemon, or a control plane driving remote edges).

didHostingUrl.description: Base URL hosted DIDs are published under. Absent when not configured.

enabledMethods.description: DID methods this build can host.

listenAddress.description: The address the service's HTTP listener is bound to.

mediatorDid.description: The messaging mediator the service is reached through. Absent when it runs without one.

publicUrl.description: Base URL of the service's own web surface. Absent when not configured.

configuredInstances.description: Instances seeded from configuration rather than registered.

serviceDid.description: The service's own DID — the issuer of its replies.

transports.description: Which messaging transports the configuration enables.

vta.description: The verifiable trust agent holding the service's identity. Absent for a self-managed deployment.

Response.title: Server Config — response payload
